data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 205.27m. During 2018 gross claims outstanding movement included a prior-year strengthening of GBP 6.76m (c.3.3% of opening reserves) driven by reserve deterioration on longer-tail classes and large loss development, together with catastrophe activity (notably Californian wildfires and Hurricane Michael). Some favourable movements on prior hurricane exposures (Harvey, Irma and Maria) partially offset the increase on a net basis.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the financial year is attributable to loss events (detailed below) and reserving movements during the year, and is reflected in the net combined ratio of 112% (2017: 117%).
The principal drivers were a combination of catastrophe events (notably Californian Wildfires and Hurricane Michael) and reserve deterioration on certain products (predominantly longer tail classes).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary source for prior year movement used: Technical provisions movement note (Gross column) which shows a gross prior year change of GBP 6.760k (= GBP 6.76m). The Managing Agent narrative and other P&L lines quote net favourable prior year development of GBP 3.9m; this is a NET figure. LOB-level prior-year movements are only presented net in the table in note 4, therefore LOB movements above are based on net figures (confidence reduced). The gross triangle is present and was used for development table extraction. There is an apparent sign/terminology inconsistency between the gross movement in the technical provisions table (a gross increase of GBP 6.76m) and the narrative stating "favourable prior year development of GBP 3.9m" (net). Following the rules, the gross movement from the technical provisions note was used as authoritative for prior_year_development_gbp_m.
